meta.note: Claims extracted from reviewed studies in glp1_studies_draft.json. Every number is checked against the quoted PubMed abstract by `concordance_pipeline.build_matrix verify`. Weight loss v1 scope: placebo-controlled trials in adults with obesity and without type 2 diabetes, at the highest approved obesity dose. Stomach side effects (v1): FDA label adverse-reaction tables at the highest approved obesity dose; value = average excess incidence of nausea, diarrhea and vomiting vs placebo, checked against the DailyMed label XML.

claims.statement: STEP 1: semaglutide 2.4 mg weekly led to 12.4 percentage points more body-weight loss than placebo at 68 weeks (adults with obesity, no diabetes).
quotes: for an estimated treatment difference of -12.4 percentage points

claims.statement: STEP 5: semaglutide 2.4 mg weekly led to 12.6 percentage points more body-weight loss than placebo at 104 weeks (adults with obesity, no diabetes).
quotes: for an estimated treatment difference of -12.6 %-points

claims.statement: OASIS 4: oral semaglutide 25 mg daily led to 11.4 percentage points more body-weight loss than placebo at 64 weeks (adults with overweight or obesity, no diabetes).
SURMOUNT-1: tirzepatide 15 mg weekly led to about 17.8 percentage points more body-weight loss than placebo at 72 weeks (-20.9% vs -3.1%; adults with obesity, no diabetes).

derivation.note: Difference of the reported arm means; the abstract gives no model-based treatment difference.

quotes: -20.9% (95% CI, -21.8 to -19.9) with 15-mg doses and -3.1% (95% CI, -4.3 to -1.9) with placebo

claims.statement: SCALE Obesity and Prediabetes: liraglutide 3.0 mg daily led to about 5.3 percentage points more body-weight loss than placebo at 56 weeks (5.6 kg difference; adults with obesity, no diabetes).

derivation.note: Approximation: the abstract reports the difference in kg (last observation carried forward), converted using mean baseline weight.

claims.statement: ATTAIN-1: orforglipron at the top trial dose (36 mg capsule) led to about 9.1 percentage points more body-weight loss than placebo at 72 weeks (-11.2% vs -2.1%; adults with obesity, no diabetes).

derivation.note: Difference of the reported arm means (treatment-regimen estimand).

quotes: -11.2% (95% CI, -12.0 to -10.4) with 36 mg of orforglipron, as compared with -2.1% (95% CI, -2.8 to -1.4) with placebo

claims.statement: FDA label (Table 3, adults with obesity or overweight): on Wegovy 2.4 mg injection, nausea 44% vs 16% on placebo, diarrhea 30% vs 16%, vomiting 24% vs 6%. On average 20.0 percentage points more often than placebo.
